resources.string: "Lists non-system apps with a launcher icon and extracted arm64 IL2CPP libraries. Selecting a game saves your choice without launching it."
"First launch, preview controls, and common questions."
"Install The Bazaar through an official channel, open this launcher, and tap “Check again”. If file access is required, tap “Grant access”, allow it, and return."

"Keep at least 1 GB free and tap “Launch game”. Keep the app in the foreground during initial preparation. The framework and plugin are bundled; game login and resource downloads still require internet access."
"Log in and wait for the game language and card data to load, then open “Card Collection”. “Builds” is available during a run. Use this launcher to start the game from now on."

"“Card Collection” supports name and description search, filters, and tier and enchantment previews. The first load may take longer. In “Builds”, select candidates from your board, stash, or shop to find matching builds. Previews do not upgrade or enchant your items."

"The “Hold” button cycles through Enchants → Upgrade → None. None keeps only the native item details. You can also select a mode under “BazaarPlusAndroid: Long press preview” in game settings. Long press shops, events, or monsters for additional information."

"Hold “Hold to preview” with one finger and tap an item, event, or monster with another. Release to exit. The monster panel stays open: tap a card for details, or tap outside or × to close. This control is hidden in standard input mode."

"The five buttons are Collection, Builds, Long press mode, Hold to preview, and Run history. Hide each button in game settings or launcher Settings → In-game buttons; both stay in sync. Hidden buttons leave no gap. Button style switches between icons and classic text. Drag any button to move the group and snap to an edge. Auto-hide collapses it after 5 idle seconds; tap BPA to expand. Preview panel position can also be changed in launcher Settings."

"The official Bazaar client is selected by default. Tap “Choose installed game” to save another client, return home, and tap “Launch game”. “Restore official game” restores the default. Each client has separate runtime data and requires its own login."
"Game missing from the list or unable to launch?"

"The list requires a launcher icon, a non-system app, and extracted arm64 IL2CPP libraries. Custom clients must match the bundled Unity version; the official client must also match a verified game version. Follow the home screen guidance. A game update may require a new launcher."
"Preparation fails or plugin controls are missing"

"Start through this launcher, allow file access, ensure enough free space, and retry from home. If it still fails, exit the game, then open “More: repair and licenses → Repair environment”. Repair applies to the selected client and preserves login, persistent data, and user settings."

"Exit the game and select “More: repair and licenses → Export diagnostics” on the home screen. Save the file and send it to the maintainer. The export contains launcher records only, excludes game logs and account or login data, and is never uploaded automatically."

"After switching apps, tap the launcher icon to return to the running game. The Android version is experimental. History, replay, video recording, uploads, and automatic updates are not available yet. Preview values and recommendations are for reference; some scenarios still need verification."

"The official Bazaar client is selected by default. You can choose another installed game with a launcher icon and extracted arm64 IL2CPP libraries. “Launch game” on the home screen starts your saved selection."
"Choose where the additional preview appears when you long press an item."
"Saved automatically. Applies the next time you launch the selected game."

"Install The Bazaar through an official channel, then return and check again. You can also select another eligible installed game in Settings. Login and game resource downloads are handled by the game."

"The runtime framework, plugin, and persistent game data are stored in this launcher’s separate shared directory. All files access is required to prepare the environment. Existing FusionCore environments are kept separate. You can return and retry if you decline."
"Verify and prepare the framework, dependencies, and bundled plugin. Login, persistent data, and user settings are preserved. Exit the running game first."
"Close this launcher and the game running inside it. The environment will be checked on the next launch. Make sure the game has saved first."
